story.title: My new house!
paragraphs_en: We are going to our new house. I am scared. When I go there, I will have to go to a new school. I will have to make new friends.
We packed our bags and set off. My mom told me that it would fun to go to a new school. I wish she is right.
We decided to take a break and eat lunch. We ate sandwich and chips. It was very delicious.
Then we walked our way to our new house. I can't wait to see my new house!
Finally we reached. We went inside and opened our bags. We made places for our things. Then my mom told me to sleep because I have to wake up early tomorrow to go to school.
I have to go to school today! My mom gave me Dosa for breakfast and told me to get ready quickly.
My mom told me to be good in school. We close the door and went outside. We have to go to school.

When we were walking, we saw a girl. She said" Hi! My name is Mira. Are you new to this place?". I looked at mom. Then I said" Hi Mira! My name is Anisha. I am new to this place and I am going to school." Mira looked happy and said that she was going to school too! I was very happy. Maybe she can be my friend.
I was right! We became good friends. She told me everything about school.
We went to school together. We played together and we did everything together!
She even came to my house to play.
